Without this, Android can stop recording on long walks once the screen is off. Strongly recommended.
Samsung phones can be especially strict. After this prompt, find Pilgrim in Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Sleeping apps, and remove it.
Xiaomi\'s MIUI can kill background services aggressively. After this prompt, also enable AutoStart for Pilgrim in Security → Permissions → Autostart.

I\'ve been walking with Pilgrim — it tracks your walks, records voice notes, and even has a meditation mode. No accounts, no tracking, everything stays on your phone. Free and open source.
Export creates a .pilgrim archive with all your walks, transcriptions, and settings. Import restores walks from a .pilgrim file.
View renders your walks at view.pilgrimapp.org. Edit opens edit.pilgrimapp.org for in-browser editing. Your walk data is not uploaded; the JSON is injected into the browser via the JS bridge.
Exports all voice recording audio files as a zip archive. These are not included in the data export.
